thread:
maya: Drafting the company-level OKR slate for FY26 Q2 — posted the Google doc, TL;DR below. Need alignment by Friday EOD so we can lock roadmap and hand to sales/marketing.

maya: TL;DR objectives: 1) Make Redwood the default inference choice for scale apps (growth + PLG motions). 2) Cut hosted per-token cost while preserving quality. 3) Enterprise readiness: Dedicated + Private compliance features. 4) Reliability: hit 99.9% uptime for Dedicated and Hosted SLOs.

maya: Key results (draft):
- KR1: +35% net new signups attributed to PLG templates and quickstarts (growth).
- KR2: Reduce median gen latency across hosted models by 15% and 95p by 20%.
- KR3: 15% reduction in per-token cost via batching + quantization recommendations (Optimize).
- KR4: Launch Private VPC GA with KMS/HSM integrations and SOC2 gap closure for 3 pilot customers.
- KR5: <1 incident per quarter causing P90 latency >2x target.

jordan (vp product): Thanks @maya. Good shape. Quick ask: can we surface a product-led metric that ties to revenue? Maybe "conversion from free trial to paid within 30 days for API" as a sub-KR?

maya: yes — added a sub-KR for trial->paid conversion target (goal +8pp). Putting in the doc now.

andre (cto): Overall thumbs up. A couple of tradeoffs: the 15% cost reduction KR relies heavily on Optimize shipping model quantization guidance and runtime batching improvements. Need engineering capacity estimate before we commit.

li (head eng): I can give a rough estimate. To hit the latency and cost KRs we need: 2 sprints for kernel selection/optimizations, 3 for KV cache autoscaling polish, and 2 for integration tests + perf lab runs. That's ~7 sprint-equivalents across eng-runtime and eng-ml. Also need one senior infra swing to finalize autoscale policies for Dedicated.

sam (eng lead): Noted. Also we should be explicit about rollback/fallback plans: if quantization causes regen quality regressions we need automatic A/B rollback and eval gates. I'll add canary gating to the rollout checklist.

olivia (growth): From GTM: if we lock the PLG templates + quickstarts KRs, marketing can run a targeted campaign that should close trials faster. We need a short list of 3 reference templates (chat widget, search rerank, embeddings for semantic search). Can product pick the top 3 by next Wed?

maya: yes — proposal in doc: chat support bot (hosted + private example), embeddings search starter (with sample dataset), and a low-latency summarization demo (shows latency wins).

andre (cto): For Private GA KR — legal/compliance dependencies could shift timelines. Ops, please flag any blocking audits. Also recommend we scope pilot to 3 customers max to reduce support load at GA.

ops-bot: FYI: SOC2 readiness checklist updated in Confluence. Current blockers: encryption at rest policy review and one penetration test slot (next available in 6 weeks).

li (head eng): Noted on pen test. That might push Private GA by 4–6 weeks if we wait for external test. We could ship with an interim attestation for pilots if legal approves.

jordan (vp product): On prioritization: we need to rank initiatives across Hosted performance, Optimize tooling, Dedicated autoscale, Private GA. My preference is: 1) Hosted perf + Optimize (consumer-facing wins), 2) Private GA pilot, 3) Dedicated autoscale polish. We should call this out in the doc and show tradeoff rationale.

maya: added ranking and a short tradeoff table. Also added acceptance criteria for each KR (metrics, owner, rollout plan).

sam (eng lead): One more technical ask: can we commit to a dedicated perf dashboard in Console for the latency/cost KRs? That'll make measurement clear. I'll pair with devex to scope.

olivia (growth): For KR measurement — please make sure we have week-by-week tracking so marketing can tie campaign spend to conversion.

maya: Agree. I added a weekly dashboard cadence and owners.

andre (cto): Final for now: we should create a contingency KR that if cost reductions don't hit target, we commit to a "unit-economics task force" to propose pricing/packaging adjustments by mid-Q. Keeps exec comfort.

jordan (vp product): Good! If no objections, I'll mark this as "draft ready for exec review" tomorrow morning and loop in finance/legal. Please review the doc by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — will iterate and publish final version once we get any major changes. Ping me directly for urgent concerns. :pray:
